description: This file is a proxy PHP script generated by Composer, used to include another PHP bin script ('jp.php') with a workaround for PHP versions below 8.0 to prevent shebang output. It defines a namespace 'Composer', sets global paths, and conditionally defines a class 'BinProxyWrapper' to handle stream operations, serving as a proxy for executing the actual script located at a relative path.

classes.name: BinProxyWrapper
classes.description: A final class that implements a stream wrapper to proxy file operations, mainly used to suppress shebang output and handle file access in PHP versions below 8.0.

methods.name: stream_open
methods.description: Opens a stream to a file, adjusting the path and handling the file handle.

methods.name: stream_read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream, with special handling to remove shebang lines on first read.

methods.name: stream_cast
methods.description: Returns the underlying handle for casting.

methods.name: stream_lock
methods.description: Applies or releases a lock on the stream.

methods.name: stream_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the stream.

methods.name: stream_tell
methods.description: Returns the current position in the stream.

methods.name: stream_eof
methods.description: Checks if end-of-file has been reached.

methods.name: stream_stat
methods.description: Returns file statistics; here it returns an empty array.

methods.name: stream_set_option
methods.description: Sets stream options; here it always returns true.

methods.name: url_stat
methods.description: Returns statistics about a file at the URL, after removing the proxy prefix.
